snippet.title: Mars Attracts - Early Access Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2760580/Mars_Attracts/

Mars Attracts is a theme park management sim set in the iconic Mars Attacks™ universe. The Game will enter Early Access on September 15, 2025. 

Build rides, hire and train staff, manage guest needs, and most importantly - abduct humans to serve as the star attractions! Craft the perfect park to appeal to your Martian guests, but don’t forget to keep your humans’ needs met too - the hideous enclosed-brained Earthlings can be prone to escape!

Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2760580/Mars_Attracts/
Web: https://www.MarsAttracts.com
Discord:   https://discord.gg/2vQQjprDcq
Facebook, X, Insta, TikTok: @OutlierSocial
